findings.issue: Length check uses >= so a trimmed query of exactly 100 characters is rejected; spec allows 100.
findings.refuter_reason: Exactly 100 characters throws SearchValidationError and returns 400; AC4 allows 100.

findings.issue: Author clause interpolates raw query into SQL (injection, 500 on a quote) and has no LIKE escaping, so % and _ act as wildcards on author.
findings.evidence: book.ts:34 `OR author LIKE '%${trimmed}%'` with only [pattern] bound.
findings.refuter_reason: Template-string SQL with only [pattern] bound; a quote breaks the statement and % and _ act as wildcards.

findings.issue: /api/books/search alias registered after /books/:id, so it 404s instead of reaching searchHandler.
findings.refuter_reason: Express matches :id first, so the alias never reaches searchHandler.

findings.issue: HTMX endpoint returns no results for empty/missing q instead of all books.
findings.refuter_reason: Missing or empty q yields no books; AC2 says an empty query returns all books.

findings.issue: Author rendered with unescaped <%- allowing stored XSS in the HTMX fragment.
tests/models/book-search.test.ts missing; no tests for 100 vs 101, whitespace-only, % and _ literals, API alias, HTMX validation and escaping.
findings.evidence: search.test.ts has one 150-char AC4 case and one HTMX case; no model test file in diff.
findings.refuter_reason: The spec requires the model test file and these cases; none exist.

findings.issue: Empty-query test checks only count; no order check, and whitespace-only and missing q are untested, hiding the HTMX [] bug.
findings.refuter_reason: AC2 names missing, empty and whitespace-only; only `?q=` is tested, by count.

findings.issue: No test at exactly 100 or 101 characters, so the >= off-by-one is undetected.
findings.refuter_reason: AC4 requires the exactly-100 boundary; the C1 bug passes the suite.

findings.issue: No test for % or _ as literals or for parameterised SQL.
findings.evidence: No test uses %, _, a quote or backslash.
findings.refuter_reason: AC5 requires them; the C2 wildcard behaviour is undetected.

findings.issue: No test for repeated q or for /api/books/search alias.
findings.evidence: No request targets /api/books/search or repeats q.
findings.refuter_reason: The spec lists both checks; the gap hides the C3 alias bug.

findings.issue: HTMX tests weak: no 'No books found.', no 400, no escaping check.
findings.refuter_reason: The spec requires these HTMX checks; the C5 unescaped author is undetected.
